fields.label: Location
fields.note: Client-side <select id="career-location">; options equal the jobLocations values embedded in the page payload. No query parameter is sent.

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: Only value present in the embedded items[].jobTypes arrays; no employment-type control is rendered on the page.

notes: Next.js careers page (id="careers-list", model.enableSearch + filters.enableJobLocation/enableJobType) ships every opening inside the __next_f payload with title/href/jobTypes/jobLocations and filters purely in client JS via #career-search and #career-location. No fetch/XHR search endpoint and no URL parameters, so the scraper must filter locally.
